name: Gmail Inbox
description: A read-only, multi-account Gmail inbox — a master-detail viewer built on the CharmIQ OAuth bridge, agent-drivable, with obvious hooks to make it read-write

charmiq.command.name: listAccounts
charmiq.command.description: List the Gmail accounts connected to this inbox

charmiq.command.name: listEmails
charmiq.command.description: List the emails currently shown, newest first. Optionally scope to one account, or pass a Gmail search to run first.

accountId.description: Scope to one account — a Connection id, an email address, or a provider account id

query.description: Optional Gmail search (from:, is:unread, newer_than:7d, free text); runs before listing

charmiq.command.name: getEmail
charmiq.command.description: Get the full readable content (text) of one email by id

outputSchema.description: The email, or null if it is not in the loaded/searched set

charmiq.command.name: selectEmail
charmiq.command.description: Open an email in the reading pane so the User sees it open

outputSchema.description: True if the email was found and opened

charmiq.command.name: loadMore
charmiq.command.description: Fetch the next page of emails for the current view

outputSchema.description: Total emails loaded after the fetch

charmiq.command.name: search
charmiq.command.description: Run a Gmail search across the connected accounts and return the matches (also updates the UI). Uses Gmail search syntax.
